candidates.claim: Switch sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/15 is an active access port in VLAN 10, although its CORP access ports must stay in VLAN 30 and only OT-facing ports may be active in VLAN 10.
candidates.remediation: Move GigabitEthernet1/0/15 back to access VLAN 30, or shut it down if it is not an approved OT-facing port.

candidates.claim: The current configuration of sw-it-01 GigabitEthernet1/0/15 sets access VLAN 10 where the approved baseline has access VLAN 30, and this deviation is not reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the change with the approved baseline by restoring access VLAN 30, or document the approval for VLAN 10.
